key_insight: PathKGen combines whole-slide image features with structured pathology knowledge to generate histopathology reports and expose part of its reasoning as graphs.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support more interpretable automated pathology reporting, but clinical usefulness and safety are not established by the abstract.
method: A visual branch uses pathology foundation models to produce image-derived tokens.
A knowledge branch queries a pathology-specific knowledge graph to produce morphology-based knowledge tokens.
A multimodal large language model uses both token streams for report generation.
evidence_signal: On WSI-Bench, the authors report performance exceeding previous state-of-the-art methods, but the abstract provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Reasoning graphs reveal only part of the process and do not establish that generated reports are correct.
paper_title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
